proves.claim: The solo low-stakes branch of notBuilder refuses LOW_STAKES_FORGED when a snapshot row says low for a row the item froze at team, critical or without stakes.

moves.lifecycle-rules.low-stakes-forged-.why: The board record, never the snapshot a caller builds, decides row stakes, so a forged low row cannot self-accept (#1084).

proves.claim: The solo branch admits the self-accept only when every snapshot row stakes equals the frozen record, and a move from the relay and one from the cli reach the same answer.

moves.lifecycle-rules.low-stakes-frozen-.why: One rule over the item's frozen record serves local verify and the relay move path alike (#1084).
